import re

# Parse the verified data into a clean text format
lines = verify_data.split('\n')
text_lines = []
text_lines.append("=" * 100)
text_lines.append("CONFIRMED ORDERS REPORT")
text_lines.append("=" * 100)
text_lines.append(f"{'Order ID':<14} {'Customer':<20} {'Date':<14} {'Total Paid':<12} Items")
text_lines.append("-" * 100)

order_count = 0
total_revenue = 0

for line in lines:
    # Skip header row and empty lines
    if 'Order ID' in line and '(1,' in line:
        continue
    # Match data rows
    match = re.findall(r'\(\d+, \d+\): ([^\t]+)', line)
    if match and len(match) == 6:
        order_id, customer, date, status, items, total = match
        order_count += 1
        total_val = int(total) if total.isdigit() else 0
        total_revenue += total_val
        text_lines.append(f"{order_id:<14} {customer:<20} {date:<14} ${total_val:<11} {items}")

text_lines.append("-" * 100)
text_lines.append(f"Total Confirmed Orders: {order_count}")
text_lines.append(f"Total Revenue: ${total_revenue}")
text_lines.append("=" * 100)

text_content = '\n'.join(text_lines)
print(text_content)
